transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling really down and sad all the time. It's been going on for about a year and a month now, and it just doesn't seem to lift. I just feel constantly depressed.
Have there been any periods of at least two months during the past year when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood been present כמעט every day without a break?
No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This low mood has been present almost every single day for the past year and a month. I haven't felt like my usual self even for a short time.

Major Depressive Disorder is less likely because the duration and chronic, non-remitting course fit Persistent Depressive Disorder better.
